notes: New title bar in the app's colours: drag it to move the window, double-click to maximize or restore, with Windows' own minimize, maximize and close buttons
Pop out the voice room, a shared screen or the member list into their own windows; it is the same call, nothing is doubled
Resize or hide the channel list and the member list; the voice room now uses all the space between them
The window reopens where you left it, and never off-screen after a monitor is unplugged

Known limitations in this beta: chat and direct messages can't be popped out yet, computer sound is not shared with the screen yet, and some strict networks may need a relay server that is not set up yet
